pr_title: changefeedccl: correctly handle old-style protobufs in rowfetcher_cache
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/82309.

Release note (bug fix): Fixed a bug where changefeeds created before
upgrading to 22.1 would silently fail to emit any data other than
resolved timestamps.

issue_context.title: cdc: changefeeds stop emitting events after an upgrade
issue_context.body:
**Describe the problem**

Changefeeds silently fail to emit data if they were created before 22.1 and are now running on 22.1.

**To Reproduce**

Create a changefeed using 21.2 with resolved timestamps. Pause it. Upgrade to 22.1. Resume the existing changefeed and write to the table. You will see resolved timestamps in your sink but not data.



Jira issue: CRDB-16282
